newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank deal dilutive in '97 - analyst.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank deal dilutive in '97 - analyst.

text.p: NationsBank Corp told analysts Friday its planned merger with Boatmen's Bancshares Inc will cause earnings dilution in 1997, be slightly accretive to earnings in 1998 and produce more accretion in 1999, said an analyst who heard the presentation.

The analyst said NationsBank projected pro forma earnings of $8.48 per share in 1997 versus a Wall Street consensus view before the merger news that NationsBank would earn $8.98 per share, the analyst said.
The transaction, involving an exchange of shares and possibly a cash component, is expected to close January 1997.
Nationsbank projected pro forma earnings of around $10.00 per share in 1998 and $11.27 per share in 1999 versus consensus views of $9.97 per share and $11.07 respectively, the analysts said.
A spokesman for NationsBank was not immediately available for comment. Earlier, the regional banking powerhouse said the merged entity would have net earning power of nearly $3 billion in 1997.
NationsBank was down 6-5/8 to 85-3/4 in midmorning composite trading and Boatmen's was up 10-11/16 to 53-5/8.
The deal, which will be tax free in its share component, is valued at about $9 billion, taking into account the drop in value of NationsBank shares as of midmorning Friday.
